item.itunes:title: BEST OF THE HERD – Epic World Series | 49ers & Seahawks Make Big Moves | Super Bowl Bubble: Chiefs IN, Ravens OUT
item.description:
Colin Cowherd talks about the Tampa Bay Rays fighting to stay alive in the World Series with a thrilling extra innings win over the Milwaukee Brewers. He shares his latest Super Bowl Bubble of contenders: the Chiefs remain in despite their first loss, but the Ravens are out after falling to last place in the AFC North.

item.description:

item.itunes:title: BEST OF THE HERD – Rams Devastating Loss | Josh Allen’s First OT Win | Dodgers On The Brink | Herd Hierarchy: 49ers, Chiefs, Bills, Ravens
item.description:
Colin Cowherd reacts to the Rams loss to the Bills due to another disastrous performance from their special teams including 2 missed field goals. Colin explains why this has always been an issue for the Rams under head coach Sean McVay and why this may be the reason they fail to win another Super Bowl.

He also credits Josh Allen for carrying the Bills to another win despite the defense giving up 34 points and a fumble by James Cook in overtime that nearly cost Buffalo the game.

Colin shares his updated Herd Hierarchy after week 5: 49ers are 1st, Chiefs are 3rd and the Broncos hang on to 10th.

Plus, long time NFL writer Peter King joins the show to talk about the connection between Patrick Mahomes - Andy Reid and the Chiefs returning to Super Bowl contention.
